datasets.name: Mozilla Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 - Amharic

datasets.name: Google FLEURS Amharic

policy: Only ingest datasets whose licenses and platform access terms permit the intended use. Do not train a voice clone of an identifiable speaker without consent. Do not mix validation/test into training.
